title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention mechanisms for machine translation.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract: BERT introduces bidirectional pre-training for language representations and improves results on a wide range of natural language processing tasks.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
abstract: Vision Transformer applies a pure transformer directly to image patches and performs well on image recognition tasks when pre-trained at scale.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract: Large language models demonstrate strong few-shot performance across many NLP benchmarks without task-specific fine-tuning.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract: LoRA freezes pre-trained model weights and injects trainable low-rank matrices, reducing the number of trainable parameters for adaptation.
